segments.segment_summary: A person holds a smartphone, displaying a recipe for chicken parmesan on a laptop screen. The setting appears to be a kitchen.

key_moments.caption: A hand holding a smartphone is pointed towards a laptop screen.
The laptop screen shows a recipe for chicken parmesan, listing ingredients like chicken breast and breadcrumbs.

segments.segment_summary: A person prepares the components for chicken parmesan. They whisk an egg in a bowl and mix breadcrumbs with parmesan cheese on a plate before coating a chicken breast.

key_moments.caption: An egg is cracked into a white bowl and whisked.
Breadcrumbs and grated parmesan cheese are combined on a white plate.
A raw chicken breast is dipped into the egg wash.
The egg-washed chicken is coated in the breadcrumb mixture.

segments.segment_summary: Breaded chicken cutlets are pan-fried in a hot skillet with oil. They are cooked on both sides until golden brown and then placed on a paper towel-lined plate to drain.

key_moments.caption: Breaded chicken cutlets are placed into a hot pan with sizzling oil.
A spatula is used to flip the chicken, revealing a golden-brown cooked side.
The fried chicken cutlets are removed from the pan and placed onto a plate with a paper towel.

segments.segment_summary: In a glass baking dish, the fried chicken cutlets are assembled for baking. Marinara sauce is layered on the bottom, followed by the chicken, more sauce, and a generous topping of mozzarella and parmesan cheese.

key_moments.caption: Marinara sauce is spread on the bottom of a glass baking dish.
The fried chicken cutlets are arranged in the dish.
More marinara sauce, shredded mozzarella, and grated parmesan cheese are layered on top of the chicken.
A final shot shows the fully assembled chicken parmesan, ready for the oven.

segments.segment_summary: The chicken parmesan is baked in the oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly. After being removed, it's garnished with fresh parsley, and a piece is served onto a white plate, showing a cheese pull.

key_moments.caption: The baking dish is placed into a preheated oven.
A time-lapse shot shows the cheese melting and browning on top of the chicken in the oven.
The finished dish is garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
A spatula lifts a piece of chicken parmesan from the dish, creating a long cheese pull.
